title: Water Pipe Failure Prediction and Risk Identification
name: UCxxxxx_Water_Pipe_Failure_Risk_Identification
description: This use case develops a machine learning workflow for predicting water pipe failure risk using historical water main break data and infrastructure asset information. The project compares Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost models using the Kitchener water network dataset and adapts the findings to Melbourne water infrastructure data. The workflow also demonstrates risk scoring, interactive dashboard visualisation, and LLM-assisted maintenance recommendation generation for proactive asset management.
expected_output: Risk scoring workflow for Melbourne water assets
Identification of key pipe failure risk drivers
